Package test

Class SlotMachineCC4Test

java.lang.Object
test.SlotMachineCC4Test
public class SlotMachineCC4Test extends Object
Shared tests of cycle 4 written by other groups. Only the ones that work with this project were kept, adapted to JUnit 5. The machine is never made visible, so no window is opened.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Oscar Poveda, Elian Ibarra
